svg.title: ask-my-site architecture
svg.desc: Build time: pages are chunked per heading, embedded, quantized to int8 and written to a static ask-index.json. Request time: the dialog posts a question, the handler embeds it, runs BM25 and cosine search over the index in memory, fuses the rankings with reciprocal rank fusion behind a relevance gate, and either answers "I don't know" without calling the model or streams a cited answer back over Server-Sent Events.
